newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Heartland Wireless Q2 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Heartland Wireless Q2 net loss widens.

text.p: (All data above millions, except per share numbers)

NOTE: Heartland Wireless Communications inc said its net income for the second quarter of 1997 included charges for increased customer service calls, additional non-pay disconnects, increased collections efforts including some outsourcing costs, additional subscriber receivables writeoffs and true-up of programming cost accruals resulting from recent programming contract audits approximate $2.5 million
The company was not immediately available to discuss its data for the first six months of either 1996 or 1997 or its average shares outstanding for the second quarter of 1997 or 1996.
